hook.name: HalloMarketsFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for HalloMarkets launchpad pools. Charges ETH fees between 1–5% on buys (via beforeSwap delta on input) and sells (via afterSwap delta on output), scaling the fee based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient on every swap.
